required: Details of the presenting condition, including symptoms and their duration, and impact on activities of daily living
Patient health summary (such as relevant medical history, relevant investigations, current medications and dosages, immunisations, allergies and/or adverse reactions), specifically including:
HbA1c (if diabetes is present or suspected)
if_available: Family history of sudden cardiac death or cardiac disease
History of smoking, vaping, alcohol intake and drug use (including recreational drugs)
If symptoms may be linked to SARS COV-2 (COVID-19) infection or Long COVID-19
Relevant investigation results (e.g. cardiac imaging, stress test, myocardial perfusion scan, previous cardiac surgery reports)
triage: Category 1 — Recommended to be seen within 30 calendar days — New chest pain or discomfort of a probable cardiac origin in the absence of Emergency criteria
Category 2 — Recommended to be seen within 90 calendar days — Chronic chest pain or discomfort of a suspected coronary or non-coronary cardiac origin in the absence of Emergency criteria
Category 3 — Recommended to be seen within 365 calendar days — Chest pain or discomfort of an unlikely cardiac origin with no identified cause following investigation
note: Required items 5-13 are published by NSW as sub-items of 'Patient health summary ... specifically including:'; they are listed flat here.
